messages:
morgan: Heads-up: found a weird behavior with our Kotlin SDK on Android 14 where Call.timeout() seems ignored when using our retrofit CallAdapter + coroutine suspend wrapper. Repro steps in sampleapp.

eli: oh no. can you paste minimal repro?

morgan: Steps:
1) open sampleapp v2 (branch: fix/timeouts-demo)
2) trigger streaming request (RetryInterceptor + Authenticator)
3) rotate network quickly
Observed: connect timeout fires, but coroutine doesn't cancel, okhttp still holds socket
Logs and snippet:
```java
// retrofit builder
Retrofit.Builder()
  .callFactory(okHttpClient)
  .addCallAdapterFactory(OurCoroutineCallAdapter())
```

sam: is this only with OurCoroutineCallAdapter or also with default kotlinx coroutines adapter?

morgan: only observed with our adapter + authenticator that replays requests on 401. suspect cancellation logic in adapter not propagating to okhttp call.

nora: reprobed on emulator (Android 14) and on Pixel 8. exception stack: 'java.io.InterruptedIOException: timeout' but coroutine kept running.

eli: can you dump thread stack when it hangs? also what okhttp version?

morgan: okhttp 5.0.0-alpha.2 in sampleapp (we haven't upgraded). stack dump attached: CI bot posted artifact link.

ci-bot: :link: Build artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/sampleapp/2751000000/timeout-hang/logs.txt

sam: quick fix attempt: add `call.timeout().cancel()` on coroutine cancellation in adapter. try patching locally?

morgan: tried that: cancels okhttp call but Authenticator will create a new call and then old coroutine resumes handling response -> duplication and double-callbacks. need to ensure cancellation triggers Authenticator to not replay.

nora: possible approach: keep a per-call id in Request.tag and Authenticator checks 'isCancelled' and avoid replaying if so.

eli: we should also ensure parity with Java SDK - our Java calladapter already had cancellation propagation. maybe kotlin adapter missed synchronization.

morgan: filed issue #DEVEX-3121 with logs and sampleapp branch. linking to PR when ready.

sam: :thumbsup: can you drop minimal stack and repro gist here? I'll take first pass.

morgan: pushed gist and sample patch: https://gist.github.com/morgan/timeout-hang-repro. also toggled okhttp dispatcher to allow retry queue logging: `dispatcher.executorService().toString()`

eli: note: this may also affect streaming endpoints (we saw truncated chunks) — add to regression suite.

nora: I'll add an emulator integration test for Android 14 + Pixel config, and add to flaky tests label.

morgan: :thanks: will coordinate with eng-oncall for a patch release if urgent.

ci-bot: Reminder: create release note if backporting to stable SDK.
